entries.35faae923546695a: A company engaged in the Kimono Business, which sells and rents kimono and furisode and holds kimono dressing classes, and the Wedding Business, which operates wedding venues in Japan and China.
entries.481a710bbe07f225: Differences from other companies can be read as: the company has built a furisode planning and sales system that handles everything from design through fabric selection, manufacturing and sales; it can provide services in stores from furisode purchase through pre-ceremony photo shoots to makeup and dressing on the day of the Coming-of-Age Ceremony; and it has kept prices low through a purchasing system that buys kimono products from manufacturers for cash. In the Wedding Business, it handles food, floral arrangement, beauty, photography and other services in-house and has a system in which it meets customers directly to discuss their plans.

entries.4eb3530cdc0eaffb: It operates the kimono-wearing class “Ichiru” and, in addition to guidance on how to wear kimono, provides opportunities to wear kimono through outings in kimono and regeneration through shikkai.

entries.639c75393edaf149: It operates “Camelot Hills” in Saitama Prefecture, “Glastonia” and “Hyakkaro” in Nagoya City, and “Neos Mirabel” in Fuefuki City, Yamanashi Prefecture, and it also operates the photo studio “Studio Merlin” in Kita-ku, Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture.

entries.86333d6098bb832a: For the Wafuku Business, it cites improving branding through store openings in high-traffic locations; acquiring repeat customers through repair businesses such as shikkai and recycling; strengthening partnerships with photo studios and beauty salons; building systems that lead to store traffic; expanding wearing classes; strengthening a system that handles furisode from planning through sales; and promoting services that offer pre-ceremony photo shoots and dressing in stores. For the Wedding Business, it cites maintaining and strengthening a production system in which food, photography, floral arrangement and beauty are handled in-house by each department; establishing its business in China; offering plans suited to seasons and formats; and strengthening advertising.
entries.a8f8a8a54d7a2a7c: In Shanghai, China, it operates two facilities of the Jiamei Lude Gaoduan Hunli Huiguan: the Daning store and the Hongqiao store.
